Deciphering your message:
> **"What gas do plants absorb from the air to carry out photosynthesis?"**

Plants absorb **carbon dioxide ($\text{CO}_2$)**.

---

### Key Details
* **How they absorb it:** Through tiny pores on their leaves, stems, and other organs called **stomata**.
* **The process:** Using sunlight captured by chlorophyll, plants combine **carbon dioxide** and **water ($\text{H}_2\text{O}$)** to produce **glucose ($\text{C}_6\text{H}_{12}\text{O}_6$)** for energy, releasing **oxygen ($\text{O}_2$)** back into the air as a byproduct.

$$\text{6 CO}_2 + \text{6 H}_2\text{O} + \text{light energy} \longrightarrow \text{C}_6\text{H}_{12}\text{O}_6 + \text{6 O}_2$$
